title: The end of the opening day is in the offset of the device that set up: a device behind UTC (decision X9)
story: Set up on a device at -05:00 on Sun 22 Nov 2026 with a bank figure of 100,000 and no time: the opening covers its whole day, to the end of 22 Nov at -05:00. A 3,000 spend that evening at 20:00 -05:00 (01:00 on 23 Nov in UTC) is inside the opening. A 2,000 spend on Mon 23 Nov at 08:00 -05:00 comes after it. Before X9 the end of the day was midnight UTC (19:00 at -05:00), so the evening spend was taken off again. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 1,000.00 (opening, Sun 22 Nov, its whole day at -05:00, the evening spend inside it) - 20.00 (Mon 23 Nov) = 980.00
